QUOTE: "`ServerManager::execute`, after approval. A match returns an error result and the tool never runs. The deny list is therefore enforced even when approval said yes, which makes it the one hard gate."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says the deny list is checked in ServerManager::execute and is "the one hard gate". It says the allow list only skips the approval callback, so deny is the only list that blocks execution.
